notes: Kev-0.8B (litert-community/Kev-0.8B-LiteRT v2); source jaredpalmer/kev-0.8b @ v1.0 (Apache-2.0) on Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base, d = 1024. Typed decisions (noul / choice / score) over a state and a question, rendered with the author's to_record + encode (Kev repo tokenizer.json). Row graph = state-free row prefill, one signature serving_default: ids int32 [1,L] + valid float32 [1,L] -> hidden float32 [1,L,d] (after the final RMSNorm, every position); pair graph = shared-state prefill, two signatures: state_prefill_<Ls> (ids + valid of the state) -> 48 state tensors, and question_step_<Ls>_64 (the state + a 64-token question row) -> hidden [1,64,d]. The pointer head and the answer shaping run on the host in fp32. Storage: FULLY_CONNECTED weights fp16 (FLOAT_CASTING, DEQUANTIZE), embedding table int8. v2 = the release rebuilt on the final GatedDeltaNet kernel (rounds 9-18): rows L64 / L128 / L256 = form C7 (form C + a size-1 SUM after the in_proj_z and q_proj FCs, which keeps the HTP sigmoid accurate; fp32-identical to C), rows L512 / L1024 / L2048 and both pairs = form C (R64 chunk kernel + softplus / exp-clamp / decay-sum rewrites + the power-of-two gated-norm scale vs6). Shipping GPU setting: GpuOptions(precision = FP16_WITH_FP32_ACCUM). This file: kev-0.8b_sharedstate_Ls256_Lq64_fp16fc_i8emb.tflite = run-dir kev08b_sharedstate_Ls256_Lq64_v2_fp16fc_i8emb_r14B-vs6.tflite (form C). artifact_sha256 = its line in staging_v2/Kev-0.8B-LiteRT/SHA256SUMS, equal to the sha256 the phone runs staged (device/r14/inputs_r14_C.json, device/r14/s_graphs.txt MATCH lines). Landed 2026-10-05 (DECISIONS #190): the v2 bytes are on the Hub, litert-community/Kev-0.8B-LiteRT commit bba51e1c (uploaded 2026-10-05 10:57 JST); an anonymous API tree read at 2026-10-05 16:29 JST shows this file's LFS oid equal to artifact_sha256. Records and numbers are as staged (#187 / #189). soc from the phone's own QNN line 'prepare_options.cc:342:STAT: soc_type=SM8850' (device/r17/B/kev_s26_r17_B_N7_64_npucpu_jit_cold_c7.logcat_all.txt).
